title: ipomoea wolcottiana subsp. calodendron
intro: Ipomoea wolcottiana subsp. calodendron, commonly known as the Moonflower, is a species of flowering vine in the Convolvulaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to reduce anxiety and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Moonflower include sedation, anxiolysis, and muscle relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy for stress and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Ipomoea wolcottiana subsp. calodendron include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which have been shown to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
